 Bianca Censori leaves little to the imagination in plunging jumpsuit and glamorous '70s-inspired hair transformation
 Bianca was also photographed spending time with North West, Kanye's eldest daughter with his ex-wife, Kim Kardashian.
 © Byline: EVGA, SOVE, SPOT / Daily Stardust / BACKGRID / GROSBY GROUP 
 Daniel Neira Senior Writer NOVEMBER 5, 2026 2:18 PM EST NOV 5, 2026, 2:18 PM EST 
 Bianca Censori  is no stranger to making a bold fashion statement, and her latest appearance was no exception. The Australian architect  stepped out in another of her signature revealing ensembles on Wednesday, November 4, attending  Kanye West's Yeezy fashion show in Los Angeles , where she joined her husband and his four children.

 Continue reading 
 For the occasion, Bianca embraced her daring  sense of  style in a skin-tight, cream-colored jumpsuit  featuring  an extremely plunging neckline that extended  all the way down  to her waist.  The fitted design left much of her torso exposed, creating a striking silhouette that immediately commanded attention. 
 Bianca Censori leaves little to the imagination in a plunging cream-colored jumpsuit featuring a dramatic neckline and matching lace-up boots. 
 The long-sleeved ensemble  featured  a soft, velvety texture and a front zipper  that remained  almost entirely undone.  Bianca completed the monochromatic look with matching knee-high lace-up boots featuring pointed toes and slender heels, adding an edgy touch to the otherwise neutral outfit. 
 While the revealing design was undoubtedly the centerpiece of her appearance, her glamorous beauty transformation was equally eye-catching. 
 Bianca Censori embraces a glamorous new beauty look: 
 Moving away from  some of  the slicked-back hairstyles and minimalist beauty looks she  has  favored in the past, Bianca opted for a voluminous, retro-inspired  hairstyle  that gave her latest appearance a distinctly different feel. 
 © Byline: EVGA, SOVE, SPOT / Daily Stardust / BACKGRID / GROSBY GROUP Bianca Censori channels '70s glamour with voluminous caramel-brown curls, wispy bangs, smoky eye makeup and glossy nude lips. 
 Her warm, caramel-brown hair  was styled with  soft, sculpted curls that framed her face, while wispy, eyebrow-grazing bangs added a playful touch.  The bouncy, shoulder-length  hairstyle  evoked the glamorous blowouts of the 1970s,  offering a contrast to  the modern, barely-there design of her outfit. 
 Bianca also leaned into a more dramatic makeup look, emphasizing her eyes with dark, smoky eyeshadow, defined eyeliner  and  long lashes.  Her complexion  appeared  luminous, with softly contoured cheeks and a glossy nude-pink lip  completing the beauty  look. 
 © Byline: EVGA, SOVE, SPOT / Daily Stardust / BACKGRID / GROSBY GROUP Bianca Censori puts her signature revealing style on display in a fitted, neutral-toned ensemble during Kanye West's latest Yeezy presentation. 
 She kept her accessories minimal, allowing her outfit and hairstyle to take center stage. A few rings provided the finishing touches to an ensemble that stayed true to her unmistakable fashion aesthetic. 
 Bianca Censori joins North West for a family fashion outing: 
 Bianca was also photographed spending time with  North West , Kanye's eldest daughter  with  his ex-wife, Kim Kardashian.  The pair  appeared  comfortable  in each other's company , walking arm in arm during the event. 
 © Byline: SPOT, SOVE, EVGA / BACKGRID / GROSBY GROUP Bianca Censori walks arm in arm with North West, who sports electric-blue hair, an oversized black coat and chunky boots. 
 North, who has been developing her own experimental fashion identity, stood out with her long, electric-blue hair,  which she wore  loose over an oversized black coat. She completed her look with chunky black boots, creating a dramatic contrast with Bianca's fitted, neutral-colored ensemble. 
 The outing marked another public appearance for the stepmother and stepdaughter, who also attended ComplexCon together in October. Bianca even  made an appearance  in North's behind-the-scenes vlog from the festival. 
 © Byline: SPOT, SOVE, EVGA / BACKGRID / GROSBY GROUP Bianca Censori joins her stepdaughter North West at Kanye West's Yeezy fashion show in Los Angeles on November 4, 2026. 
 The fashion presentation was a family affair for Kanye, whose four children with Kim Kardashian,  North, Saint, Chicago and Psalm , were all in attendance. 
 The rapper and designer presented Yeezy Season 01 at Droam 1, the brand's first flagship store, marking his first major runway presentation since his Paris show in 2022. 
 © WWD via Getty Images North West, Kanye West, Psalm West, Chicago West and Saint West at Yeezy Season 01 Runway Show 
 Models dressed in monochromatic ensembles walked around a white mound as Kanye unveiled his latest designs. The musician also greeted attendees wearing an all-black leather outfit, complete with lace-up boots and an oversized gold-tone belt buckle. 
 Still, Bianca  made sure to bring  her  own  distinctive fashion perspective to the occasion, once again proving  that  she isn't afraid to experiment with bold silhouettes, dramatic beauty looks and unconventional styling.
